news.title: U.S. DOJ seeks $61 million in what it calls Iran's crypto-laundered black market oil sales
news.summary: Prosecutors have filed a civil forfeiture complaint against what they call Iran's illegal crypto proceeds that are used to fund its military.

news.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, narrowing the gap with Ethereum
news.summary: Transaction V1 raises Solana’s limit to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, giving developers more room for multi-step trades, company-wallet approvals and privacy proofs.

news.title: Democrats send counteroffer to Republicans over Clarity Act provisions
news.summary: Democratic Senators were said to be meeting late Monday to discuss the latest proposed draft text.

news.title: U.S. House panel shares crypto tax bill ahead of hearing later this week
news.summary: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking and other issues for which the industry's clamored for policies.

news.title: Bitcoin slips to $77,800 as Senate Clarity Act vote nears and oil prices climb
news.summary: Bitcoin pulls back from $79,000 as the Senate prepares to vote on the Clarity Act and oil prices rise.

news.title: Even if Clarity fails, Wall Street’s crypto push is unlikely to stop
news.summary: The Clarity Act could give banks, brokers and asset managers a clearer rulebook, but financial firms have already moved far enough into digital assets that failure may slow adoption rather than stop it.

news.title: SEC's Atkins backs Clarity Act but says agency will keep pushing crypto rules without it
news.summary: The SEC chair said crypto issuance, transfer agent modernization and custody will form the backbone of the agency’s regulatory push.

news.title: U.S. Senator Lummis says Democrats won't quit asking for more on crypto Clarity Act
news.summary: One of the top crypto market structure negotiators in Washington says she's run out of gas on new revisions for the bill she's worked on for more than five years.

news.title: ‘He does not have a spouse or children’: My son has a serious genetic disease. What should I do with my $1.3 million estate?
news.summary: “He is also the sole beneficiary of my 403(b) accounts.”

news.title: ‘My total balance should be $20 million’: I invested $1.1 million in a crypto platform. Have I lost it all?
news.summary: “I invested on the recommendation of an executive vice president of a major New York investment bank.”

news.title: AI doomsday fears are arriving at the worst possible time for the stock market
news.summary: The latest cracks in the AI trade are emerging at a particularly troubling time for investors.

news.title: The murky AI milestone that has some of the industry’s leading voices increasingly on edge
news.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and others are warning that AI models may be able to build on themselves, without the help of humans. It’s a concept known as recursive self-improvement.

news.title: The oil market is sending an increasingly loud warning about gas prices at the pump
news.summary: Oil buyers are paying much more to get a barrel of crude oil immediately as the Iran conflict threatens global supplies.

news.title: CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks lead software stocks to a never-before-seen feat
news.summary: The software sector outperformed the chip sector to a historic degree in the face of escalating AI fears.

news.title: Chip stocks were a safe AI play. Now they’ve turned into the market’s pain trade.
news.summary: A slowdown in the pace of AI development wouldn’t necessary dent spending, but there are other reasons semiconductor investors may want to take a measured approach.
